committees.name: Conference Committee
committees.notes: Registration at 160 (35 exhibitors/sponsors). Keynote Rustin Moore signed. PetDesk secured as new sponsor. Conference & pre-conference schedule largely finalized.
committees.nextSteps: Finalize Thursday night community event, book signing, moderator assignments, and Recover session.

committees.name: JAVTE
committees.currentFocus: Summer edition to Portland; building the reviewer bench
committees.notes: June meeting finalized the summer print edition, with a backlog of articles held for future editions. Welcomed a new slate of reviewers, now 8 across 4 teams, to speed review. New 2026-2027 reviewer slate released; new rubrics created for Case Studies, Tips and Tricks, and Articles; submission-tracking spreadsheet shared with Maddie and Michele.
committees.nextSteps: Recruit authors via an AVTE Portland presentation (Amanda Hackerott and Oreta Samples); continue adding content and content areas. Meet in September to plan the Fall edition.

committees.name: Resource Exchange
committees.notes: Meeting monthly with AVTE Admin (Lisa and Michele) to align on Resource Exchange activity. Created a full-year community engagement calendar to drive library uploads; planning a conference round table on navigating the platform and a contest to spur activity during the conference.
committees.nextSteps: Upload YouTube videos and JAVTE articles; run the contest, round table, and booth at the conference; keep moving Facebook conversations and resources onto the platform; implement the engagement calendar.

committees.name: Veterinary Technician Education Specialist (VTES)
committees.notes: Committee meets regularly, updating online resources and editing the VTES exam while working with the FVTE Committee to clarify each credential's value. Updated the points/qualification resources and online application; now reviewing and updating the current exam version to be ready for candidates at or around the conference. Two candidates approved, one pending.
committees.nextSteps: After the exam update and conference (with a table promoting VTES and FVTE), build out the question library for multiple exam versions, create a proctored off-conference exam process, and promote the credential.

committees.name: Awards Committee
committees.notes: No update this cycle. The Awards Committee's work is complete at this time.

committees.name: Advocacy Committee
committees.notes: The committee was asked to review three AAVSB revision documents (VCPR model regulations, Article I, and Standards of Practice and Facility) and provided feedback.

committees.name: Leadership Development Committee
committees.currentFocus: Developing charge and direction; broader vet tech leadership pipeline

committees.nextSteps: Build out concept document for board feedback.

committees.name: Sponsorship Committee
committees.currentFocus: Reframing sponsorship as partnership in AVTE's programs
committees.notes: Priority shifted from a benefits menu to an invitation to join AVTE's journey as it develops leadership and faculty mentorship programs; benefits remain available, framed as gratitude for support. Building a postcard highlighting new program initiatives with an invitation to join the industry and leadership development journey.
committees.nextSteps: Share postcards with exhibitors and sponsors at the conference and collect contact information for August/September follow-up.

committees.name: Fellows in Veterinary Technician Education (FVTE)
committees.notes: The Sr. FVTE designation addition is ready to launch. Final revisions were made to Sr. FVTE tasks, requirements, and application.
committees.nextSteps: Ensure the assessment process and rubrics are efficient for committee reviewers.

committees.name: Membership Committee
committees.notes: Identified as a need, not yet launched. Recruitment and retention focus. Chair needed.

committees.name: Vet Tech Fall Faculty Academy
committees.currentFocus: Preparing to open applications on September 8
committees.notes: Two-day virtual intensive, board approved. Launch: week after Labor Day 2026. Cohort: 25 to 30 new vet tech faculty. Fee: $50 to $75. Mentorship through December. Co-Directors confirmed: Rebecca Newman (Appalachian State) and Laura Boarman (Owensboro CC). Third co-director role still needed. Preparations continue. Draft syllabus is nearing completion and the marketing plan is complete. Program directors survey results are in hand and shaping the program.
committees.nextSteps: Finish the draft syllabus. Open applications on September 8. Execute the marketing plan. Confirm third Co-Director.

committees.name: AVTE Standards Series (CVTEA Webinar Program)
committees.currentFocus: Restarting conversations in late August to push the program forward
committees.notes: 11-month virtual webinar series, September to July, one session per CVTEA Accreditation Standard. Board approved. Karla Lombana has agreed to co-chair. The concept is in place but needs a push. Conversations are restarting in late August to move it forward. Feeds into Resource Exchange discussion threads.
committees.nextSteps: Restart the working conversations in late August. Recruit a co-chair partner to join Karla Lombana. Recruit presenters for Standards 1 to 4. Set up Resource Exchange threads.

committees.nextSteps: Develop the marketing and outreach approach for the career center. Share a recommended direction in the October to November window for new year implementation.

committees.name: VTNE Advocacy / External Relations
committees.currentFocus: Coalition gap analysis agreed, next steps in motion ahead of September
committees.notes: Active multi-party partnership with AAVSB, AVMA, NAVTA, CVTEA, and the Canadian VMA. VTNE/CVTEA crosswalk completed. The July meeting at the AVMA Convention in Anaheim was a success, with agreement on the gap analysis and next steps identified for every group. AAVSB bylaw change proposal went public mid-May 2026. Comms plan active.
